detail.longDescription:
🚀 FeedEcho can now boost your posts on Mastodon.

If you cross-post RSS feeds with FeedEcho, flip on the new Boost toggle for your Mastodon account. Every post FeedEcho publishes gets announced by @feedbooster@feedecho.net, and anyone who follows the booster sees your echoes in their timeline.

It works like Echofeed's old boost bot. Public and unlisted posts only.

Self-hosters can run their own booster too.

https://feedecho.net

#Mastodon #RSS #selfhosted
